This pie chart depicts the distribution of task types observed in verified journalist-LLM conversations. The chart contains two slices, representing ‘Article generation’ and ‘Headline generation’. The ‘Article generation’ slice is red and occupies approximately 83.2% of the chart, while the ‘Headline generation’ slice is yellow and represents approximately 16.8% of the total. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. There is no separate legend provided. The slices are arranged in a descending order based on their proportional size, with the larger ‘Article generation’ slice appearing first, moving clockwise to the smaller ‘Headline generation’ slice.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of task types across turns from verified Wildchat journalist-LLM conversations. The chart is divided into two categories: 'Article generation' and 'Headline generation.' Article generation accounts for approximately 73.2% of the total tasks, while headline generation constitutes 26.8%. The chart highlights a significant decline in headline generation tasks compared to article generation, suggesting a shift in focus toward more comprehensive content creation. The slices are arranged in descending order by size, with the title 'Task Type' displayed centrally within the chart.
